messages:
Maya (Partnerships): quick question from the SI partner: marketplace listing requires SOC2 evidence + pen-test summary. they also asked if we can accept hashed firmware manifests instead of binaries.
Tomas (HW Partner): yes, we can do a manifest + signed hash. we'll need a clear schema for fields to include. estimate 8 business days to produce once we have the schema.
Raj (Security): accepted artifact set we can supply: (a) signed SOC2 attestation PDF, (b) one-page SOC2 summary (controls and coverage period), (c) pen-test exec summary (severity table + mitigation status), (d) manifest for any firmware/edge blobs listing sha256, build id, signed-by, and a short provenance note.
Raj (Security): redaction rules: no cryptographic metadata removed. replace binary with: {sha256, size, filename, build_tag, signing_key_id}. and attach a signed attestation from the HW vendor that the manifest corresponds to the shipped image.
Maya (Partnerships): marketplace portal also wants an "evidence contact" email and an evidence retention promise (how long we keep artifacts). what do we say?
Raj (Security): evidence contact: security@redwood.com. retention: 12 months by default for marketplace artifacts, or longer by agreement. note: do not promise permanent access to redacted underlying binaries.
Elena (Marketing): timeline dependency for joint announcement: we need SOC2 attestation final before we put "validated" badge. if attestation date slips, we can launch as "compliance: attestation pending" but partner visibility might be reduced. aim for 2-week buffer post-attestation for approvals.
Tomas (HW Partner): understood. i'll prioritize the manifest. does the manifest need a signature block? we can PGP-sign or provide an HSM-signed timestamped attestation.
Raj (Security): PGP-signed manifest is fine. HSM-signed attestation preferred if you can. include signing key fingerprint in manifest.
Maya (Partnerships): IngestBot 0 pls create presign and set ACL so only invited emails can upload. include instructions: no raw firmware uploads, only manifest and hashes.
IngestBot: presigned bucket created: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/presign/1812349999/ (expires in 6 days). recommended path: /partners/si-acme/1812349999/{manifest.json,pdf,pen-exec.pdf}. upload ACL: partner-invite-only.
Tomas (HW Partner): got it. i'll upload a sample manifest later today for schema review.
Raj (Security): when you upload, please include a short remediation statement for any high findings in the pen summary (we need closure status). i'll review within 48 hours.
Elena (Marketing): Maya, i'll draft two short marketing lines: one for "attestation confirmed" and one for "attestation pending". will share in this thread.
Maya (Partnerships): perfect. i'll also include a checklist for the partner: manifest fields, signing process, SOC2 cover letter, pen-exec template, and upload steps. will drop checklist by EOD. thanks all.
